name: Remote-applied push with client timeout
trigger: The fake transport delegates push to a local bare remote, then exits with a timeout failure after the remote ref changed.
observe: production CLI return code and PARTIAL_OUTCOME status receipt
expected: When ls-remote on the single effective push URL matches the pre-push commit and the ordinary loose source ref identity, contents, and reflog remain unchanged, the CLI reports CONFIRMED_APPLIED with rc=0; source or symbolic movement, unmatched refs, and ambiguous shapes remain unconfirmed.
